comparison.objective: Seat an access panel flush and place two retainer bars across its edges in rib slots.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar panel insertion followed by ordered placement and alignment of bridging retainers.
comparison.success_condition: Panel is flush and correctly oriented; both bars lie flat in separate slots with specified overlap and the assembly is at rest.
comparison.reason: Tests ordered close-out assembly and flush seating, not coaxial mandrel use, impact regulation, or fractured-part recovery.
